row.body: The school route slip tells the driver to radio before turning back; its attendance copy lists the field crew under “visitors.”
row.title: Radio at the school

sidecar.gloss: A school visitor list and radio instruction place a field crew on the route.
sidecar.rival_reading: A response crew could have used the same radio procedure and visitor list; the record does not identify what brought the crew there.
